text:
Samir Patel: heads up — us-central1 control plane showing raft election lag, apiserver proxy RTOs, and multiple failed GPU pool scaleouts. seeing ~3 leader flips in last 10m :thinking_face:
Olivia Chen: copying — seeing proxy 504s and tcp retransmits on apiserver nodes. logs showing 'kube-apiserver: error reading response: read tcp ...: i/o timeout'
Samir Patel: pasting snippets from the apiserver node journal:
```
Mar 10 12:34:11 kube-apiserver[1]: W0310 12:34:11.123456 1 storage_rtl.go:412] store.Ops: op failed: write failed: context deadline exceeded
Mar 10 12:34:12 kernel: [ 1234.567890] TCP: Possible SYN flood on port 6443. Dropping packet
Mar 10 12:34:13 kube-apiserver[1]: E0310 12:34:13.987654 1 wrappers.go:111] http2: response body closed
```
Tia Gomez: could be MTU/CNI churn. we upgraded calico last night on a few nodes — overlay MTU should be 1450 but some ENI interfaces are 9000. fragmentation + offload bugs cause weird retransmits.
Paul Rivera: i ran `ip link show` on node-gpu-2a: MTU=1400 on kube-veth, but underlying eni is 9000. also dmesg has 'NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0 (calico): transmit queue 0 timed out'
Mike Huang: instrumenting now — adding tcpdump on apiserver-proxy and capturing RSTs. also tailing controller-manager leader election logs.
Samir Patel: controller-manager shows repeated leader election failures: `failed to acquire lease: timed out after 5s` — tight lease + chattiness from autoscaler probably worsening it.
Olivia Chen: noticed autoscaler hitting the API hard with attach/detach calls when GPU nodes start. that burst correlates with the flips. can we slow it down?
Tia Gomez: temp mitigation: added a 30s rate limit to autoscaler between scale calls in the CA config, rolling now :hammer_and_wrench:
Paul Rivera: quick manual mitigation — cordoned the newest GPU nodes (node-gpu-2a, node-gpu-2b) to stop attach/detach thrash. leaving existing workload.
Samir Patel: after cordon + rate limit, leader flips reduced, but apiserver still logs intermittent 502/504s. tcpdump shows fragmented packets and retries.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot rolled back calico image bump (sha: 0f3a1b) at 2955554460 — rollback triggered by ops-runbook rule `cni-suspect`
Mike Huang: pcap uploaded to s3: /s3/ops/pcaps/2955554321-apiserver.pcap (contains SYN/ACK retransmit pattern)
Tia Gomez: hypothesis: MTU mismatch + kernel offload bug on some host NICs -> fragmented packets dropped on tx path -> TCP stalls -> leader election timeouts. action plan:
  1) validate MTU across veth/eni/tun on all apiserver + controlplane hosts
  2) rollback/verify calico header/mtu config (done by deploy-bot rollback)
  3) keep autoscaler rate limit and cordon new gpu nodes until stable
  4) if needed, disable GRO/GSO/TCP offloads on affected hosts as a temporary workaround
Olivia Chen: i'm running a small script to check MTU/GRO on 12 apiserver instances now, will post diff results in 10m.
Samir Patel: i've paused autoscaler scale-outs for the gpu-pool and asked infra to hold fast on any auto-rollouts. monitoring for 1h.
Mike Huang: note for follow-up: if similar incidents recur, file kernel bug with NIC vendor (we have vendor support) and run an overnight soak with MTU harmonized.
Paul Rivera: after harmonizing MTU on 8/12 nodes, apiserver retransmits dropped ~80%, raft election frequency down to 0-1 in 30m window. leaving throttles in place for 30m.
Samir Patel: update @here — after rate-limiting autoscaler, cordoning hot nodes, and calico rollback, raft election stabilized and 6443 errors dropped to baseline. we'll keep the autoscaler throttle for 30m and then cautiously re-enable. filing incident follow-up. :thumbsup:
